sourceMode: Extracted from the lossless sheets corresponding to the two user-selected boss JPEGs. No replacement image generation is used by the deterministic repository exporter.
conversion: Per-actor fixed block extraction, binary alpha threshold 0.4, no dither, 28 opaque colours, anatomy-aware registration and component-separated FX. Final Moonroot output is deterministically enlarged 4:3 from the indexed extraction master using nearest-neighbour pixels around the fixed foot anchor; sockets use the same anchor-relative transform.
paletteNote: Game crow/plant colours plus two dark petal midtones (#473344,#68435f) and game moon colour (#e9e6d6).
